thesis: Cognex (Nasdaq: CGNX), Q3 2026 10-Q filed 2026-11-05 (statements read, MD&A not in extraction) and earnings release (8-K 2026-11-04, Ex 99.1 read). Q3 revenue 313.4M vs 276.9M (+13% reported, +19% excluding a ~13M Q3 2025 one-time partnership benefit); 9M 873.1M vs 742.0M (+17.7%); 9M gross margin 70.8% vs 67.3%. Q3 NI 84.8M vs 17.7M, but Q3 2025 carried 45.2M tax expense (about 72% of pretax) so growth in GAAP profit is overstated; Q3 2026 GAAP tax rate 17.9%. 9M NI 209.3M vs 81.8M. TTM (FY25 + 9M26 - 9M25): revenue 1,105.4M, NI 241.9M. Close 48.20 (2026-11-16, down 3.62% that day) x 168,378,060 shares (cover 2026-11-01) = market cap 8,116M = 33.5x TTM NI. TTM OCF 295.6M, capex 9.5M, FCF 286.0M (yield 3.5%). Cash 694.7M plus investments 151.3M, no borrowings line seen; total liabilities 555.0M. Guidance raised: FY26 revenue 1,143M to 1,163M, adjusted EPS 1.68 to 1.72 (GAAP 9M 1.23 vs adjusted 1.31); Q4 revenue 270M to 290M. 9M buybacks 105.2M and dividends 42.8M are covered by OCF. Pending all-cash RealSense purchase (price not disclosed in the release, Q4 2026 close) funded partly by selling ~330M of bonds. Run 77 update (MD&A read): Q3 revenue 313.4M, +13% reported, +19% excluding FX and a 13M one time 2025 channel partner sale; Americas +29%, Greater China +35%, Europe -20% (consumer electronics procurement shifted to the Americas, automotive soft); gross margin 71% vs 68%, opex -7%. RealSense acquisition is 500M all cash, expected to close in Q4 2026 (Note 14); about 330M of investments were liquidated to fund it, so cash and investments of 846.0M at 2026-10-04 falls to roughly 350M after closing (approximation). Capex 9M 6.9M; 9M OCF 220.7M; buyback authorization 9.8M remaining as of 10-04.
counterthesis: At 33.5x trailing GAAP earnings and a 3.5% FCF yield, the price already assumes sustained double-digit growth and margin gains; 9M profit growth is flattered by a prior-year tax charge and by 2025 weakness, and Q3 2025 revenue included a one-time item. Machine vision is cyclical (logistics, consumer electronics, automotive) and end-market mix, tariffs and customer concentration were not found in the extracted text. Q4 guide midpoint 280M is below Q3 313M, a sequential drop. RealSense price unknown. SBC (34.3M for 9M) is not deducted from FCF. The stock fell 3.6% on 11-16 and cause not identified. Growth leans on consumer electronics and Greater China (customer concentration text unread); the 500M deal absorbs about 60% of cash and its integration and margin effect are unknown.
invalidation: Thesis fails if growth reverts to flat or negative organically, gross margin falls back toward 67%, RealSense is expensive or dilutive to returns, or end-market orders weaken in logistics or consumer electronics.
